name: Memory Setup
description_zh: 启用并配置 Moltbot/Clawdbot 记忆搜索以实现持久上下文。适用于初始化记忆、解决“金鱼脑”问题或协助用户配置 memorySearch。涵盖 MEMORY.md、日志记录及向量搜索设置。
description_en: Enable and configure Moltbot/Clawdbot memory search for persistent context. Use when setting up memory, fixing "goldfish brain," or helping users configure memorySearch in their config. Covers MEMORY.md, daily logs, and vector search setup.
